$comment: Operator decision log (scripts/analysis/decision-log.mjs; Spec 124 R-HK). Imported verbatim from the committed chat record docs/reports/decisions/raw/2026-10-23-batch-k/2026-10-23-batch-k.json. `decision_vocab`, `routing` (the register and row that record each decision), `amendments` and `options` are added by the lane and are not the operator's text; everything else is re-derived from `source.raw` by `--check`.

decisions.question: Must every declared emit be present on every run, an empty cursor included?
decisions.recommendation: Yes, as an amendment to R-DE (iv) (124a): every declared emit is present on every run; an empty cursor reads 0, never absent or N/A. Fix in compute_coa_cost_estimates red-first in its own lane, as trades did (zeroMatched); the fix moves source_fingerprint, so the cost captures need a retake. Five words: standardized (one rule, same as trades); observable (the shape no longer depends on the cursor); accurate (no NaN-nulls); scalable (every materializer); understandable (one sentence). No scope creep.
